content.name: Staff of Healing
content.reqAttune: by a bard, cleric, or druid
entries: This staff has 10 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC and spellcasting ability modifier: {@spell cure wounds} (1 charge per spell level, up to 4th), {@spell lesser restoration} (2 charges). or {@spell mass cure wounds} (5 charges).
The staff regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a {@dice d20}. On a 1. the staff vanishes in a flash of light, lost forever.

entries.name: Regaining Charges
